# Handpoint Developer Documentation

> Handpoint provides integrated payment acceptance for ISVs: a Cloud REST API for PAX SmartPOS terminals, native Android/iOS/Cordova/JavaScript/Windows SDKs, and back-office remote payment operations (remote sale, pre-auth capture, batch close). Supported acquirers: EPI (TSYS US/Canada), EmerchantPay, Paystrax, PAYSAFE, TNS.

---

Load these skills before writing integration code. The index tells you which skills to load for your acquirer and integration path.

- [Skills Index](https://developer.handpoint.com/.well-known/skills/index.json): Structured JSON index of all available skills

## Key Facts for AI Agents

- Staging: `https://cloud.handpoint.io` | Production: `https://cloud.handpoint.com`
- Auth header: `ApiKeyCloud: YOUR_API_KEY` (case-insensitive; one key per merchant)
- Rate limit: 2 requests/second per merchant API key — HTTP 429 on exceed
- POST /transactions → 202 Accepted → poll GET /transaction-result/{id} (204 = still processing, 200 = done)
- Polling: check every ~3 seconds; HTTP 204 has an empty body — do NOT call .json() on it
- POST /reversal → synchronous, HTTP 200, no finStatus in response, httpStatus is integer 200
- POST /moto/sale → synchronous, HTTP 200, reversal key is in `guid` field (not transactionID)
- POST /batch/close → synchronous, httpStatus is string "200" (differs from /reversal integer)
- Amount fields in result: requestedAmount / totalAmount / tipAmount / dueAmount (no bare `amount` in result)
- transactionReference: UUID v4 you generate; persist before sending; usable for recovery via GET /transactions/{ref}/status
  - ONLY honoured (echoed back) for: sale, refund, saleAndTokenizeCard, preAuthorization
  - For all other operations it is stripped and replaced with a system-generated value — do not rely on it for recovery of moToSale, moToRefund, preAuthorizationCapture, etc.

---

## Cloud API — Machine-Readable Reference

### finStatus Enum (GET /transaction-result response)

All 10 valid values and their semantics:

| finStatus            | Final? | Meaning and action                                                                                                                                                         |
|----------------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| IN_PROGRESS          | No     | Terminal still processing. Keep polling.                                                                                                                                   |
| UNDEFINED            | No     | Outcome unknown (network loss, timeout). Run recovery flow: GET /transactions/{transactionReference}/status. Do NOT retry the operation before recovery.                   |
| AUTHORISED           | Yes    | Approved. Card charged.                                                                                                                                                    |
| DECLINED             | Yes    | Declined by issuer. Card not charged.                                                                                                                                      |
| FAILED               | Yes    | Processing failed. Card not charged. Run recovery flow before retrying.                                                                                                    |
| PARTIAL_APPROVAL   | No*    | Edge case — NOT final. /status returns finStatus:AUTHORISED but with dueAmount > 0 and totalAmount < requestedAmount, revealing partial approval is in progress. Terminal showing accept/decline prompt. If declined: SDK auto-reverses, final result is CANCELLED. Wait 60s+ or for final transaction-result delivery. Do NOT save AUTHORISED from /status as final when dueAmount > 0. |
| CANCELLED            | Yes    | Cancelled (by cardholder or merchant). Card not charged.                                                                                                                   |
| PROCESSED            | Yes    | Non-financial operation completed (e.g. tokenizeCard). No charge.                                                                                                          |
| REFUNDED             | Yes    | Refund processed successfully.                                                                                                                                             |
| CAPTURED             | Yes    | Pre-authorization captured. Card charged for captured amount.                                                                                                              |

*PARTIAL_APPROVAL: /status shows AUTHORISED immediately, but check dueAmount > 0 to detect partial-approval-in-progress. Final transaction-result delivers PARTIAL_APPROVAL (accepted) or CANCELLED (declined). Always wait for transaction-result; never act on /status AUTHORISED alone when dueAmount > 0.

### POST /transactions — `operation` Values

All valid values for the `operation` field:

sale, refund, saleAndTokenizeCard, tokenizeCard,
moToSale, moToRefund, moToPreAuthorization, moToReversal,
preAuthorization, preAuthorizationIncrease, preAuthorizationCapture, preAuthorizationReversal,
saleReversal, refundReversal,
stopCurrentTransaction, pingDevice, printReceipt

### Amount Units — CRITICAL: two different conventions

| Endpoint                                    | `amount` unit    | Format            | Example              |
|---------------------------------------------|------------------|-------------------|----------------------|
| POST /transactions                          | Minor units       | Digits only, no decimal point | "1000" = $10.00 |
| POST /moto/sale                             | Major-unit decimal | Decimal string   | "10.00" = $10.00    |
| POST /moto/refund                           | Major-unit decimal | Decimal string   | "10.00" = $10.00    |
| POST /reversal                              | Major-unit decimal | Decimal string   | "10.00" = $10.00    |

Mixing up minor/major units is the most common integration bug. Always verify which endpoint you are calling.

### POST /transactions — Required Fields

Always required:
- `operation` — operation type (see list above)
- `serial_number` — terminal serial number
- `terminal_type` — terminal model identifier

Required for financial operations (sale, refund, preAuthorization, moToSale, moToRefund, moToPreAuthorization, and other money-moving ops):
- `amount` — in minor units (digits only, no decimal)
- `currency` — ISO 4217 currency code (e.g. "USD", "EUR")

Required for reversal / modification operations:
- `originalTransactionId` — required for: saleReversal, refundReversal, moToReversal, preAuthorizationIncrease, preAuthorizationCapture, preAuthorizationReversal

### transactionReference Scope

`transactionReference` (UUID v4, caller-generated) is honoured ONLY for these operations:
- sale
- refund
- saleAndTokenizeCard
- preAuthorization

For all other operations (tokenizeCard, moToSale, moToRefund, moToPreAuthorization, moToReversal, preAuthorizationIncrease, preAuthorizationCapture, preAuthorizationReversal, saleReversal, refundReversal, stopCurrentTransaction, pingDevice, printReceipt) the field is stripped and replaced with a system-generated value. Recovery via GET /transactions/{transactionReference}/status is only reliable for the four operations above.
